title.narrative: Demonstration initiative on community based forest management and REDD+ in Sabah

description.narrative: Project aims to contribute to the sustainable and low carbon development of the State of Sabah. It's specific objective is to improve Sabah's REDD+ readiness and implementation through demonstration activities to strengthen community engagement in forest protection and pro-poor sustainable forest management.

title.narrative: Number of households benefitting from forestrelated sustainable livelihoods and community support for conservation. Increase in income per household in targeted villages.

description.narrative: 250 HH in minimum 6 villages have experienced an increase in income by Year8.Indigenous people and local communities are already willing to work with Government and NGOs on conserving forest resources and developing alternative sustainable sources of income.Average monthly income for poor household in Sabah is RM1,050/month.

comment.narrative: Gana year 2000 627 households with monthly incomes RM800.Kinabatangan 2014 390 people in 4 villages with monthly income RM1000month RM1100month.average income for family with oil palm plantation is higher RM1600 to RM1700 per monthEcolinc 11000 people 31 villages with monthly income RM300month RM1100month.

405 HH of the 495 HH involved in the 3 pilot sites have experienced an increase in income in the reporting period.Gana 231HH303HH in 10 villages in Gana.Kinabatangan 114HH122HH in 4 villages in Kinabatangan.Ecolinc 60HH70HH in 7 villages in Ecolinc.

title.narrative: Increase in the number of tourists/visitors to the community ecotourism sites.(*Ecolinc Pilot Site)

description.narrative: Increase in the number of tourists/visitors to the community ecotourism sites.(*Ecolinc Pilot Site)At least 25% increase in the number of tourists/visitors to community ecotourism sites.

comment.narrative: No baseline for communitybased ecotourism.2013 Indirectly 311948 visitors to other areas of the Park which includes the CCAs.

Through Projects intervention the Project have successfully expanded the initial target to all three 3 pilot sites. All three 3 pilot sites have successfully developed their own communitybased ecotourism site by the end of Year8.In Gana pilot sites 845 visitors were recorded to the Kokobuan Waterfall recreational site.In Ecolinc 300 visitors were recorded to the Projects ecotourism sites. The total visitors of 1145 is equivalent to 0.65 of the total visitors to SFDs Nature Sites 20192020.In Kinabatangan the homestay programme in Kg. Balat is being put on hold because of the pandemic. But since early 2022 it gained momentum in improving the community infrastructure and readiness to receive tourist in near future.

title.narrative: Number of communities involved and benefit from the REDD activities in Sabah.

description.narrative: 250 households (Gana 100 households; Kinabatangan 90 households; Ecolinc 60 households) in minimum 6 villages to be involved and benefitted from REDD activities in Sabah.

comment.narrative: Gana 627 households 2000 census for the 10 villages within Gana 2000 people.Kinabatangan 2014 social baseline on 4 villages 390 people.Ecolinc 11000 people residing in 31 villages in the project area.

As of 30th November 2021 495 households were actively involved in the Project Gana 303 households Kinabatangan 122 households Ecolinc 70 households. Based on the socioeconomic baseline data 99 of the 303 households in Gana 87 of the 122 households in Kinabatangan and 93 of the 70 households in Ecolinc fall within the poor to extreme poor categories.

description.narrative: 20% increase in forest area under community comanagement arrangements by Year 8.20% increase or 1,686 ha to be planted or restored by Year 8.

comment.narrative: In 2013 a total of 1405 hectares have been planted in various Community Forestry Project.Source SFD 2013 Annual Report Chapter 17

As of 30th November 2021 1401.90 Ha of forest areas has been restored which is equivalent to 83 achieved against the total targeted amount. Total size of forest area restored through Community Forestry Projects in 2013 1405 Ha 1401.90 Ha restored under the Sabah EUREDD Project intervention 2806.90 Ha.

title.narrative: 30% increase in budget allocated from State agencies for projects and activities related to communitybased forest management.

description.narrative: 30% increase in budget allocated from State agencies for projects and activities related to communitybased forest management.30% increase or RM1,278,547.50/EU 285,460.16 by Year 8.

comment.narrative: In 2013 a total of RM4261825 EUR1020698.62 has been allocated by the Sabah State on Community Forestry Project Source SFD 2013 Annual Report Chapter 17.

2021 RM3876256.32 EUR817508.27 allocated for communitybased forest management. It slightly decreased due to the limitation in physical implementation of projects affected by Covid19 pandemic. The previous reporting period have shown steadily increases of allocated fund for communitybased forest management.
